basis: 1977 Factory LaScala Dimensions, two-page scan posted in Klipsch community; community copy, authenticity not independently certified
height_choice: 1977 drawing 35-1/4 in used consistently; later brochure 35-1/2 in is not silently mixed into geometry
coordinate_system: mm; X centered across width, Y increases from front to rear, Z up; floor at Z=0
uncertainties: Doghouse roof blank length/bevel notes do not fully reconcile with assembled section dimensions. R1 uses section geometry with continuous constant-thickness walls and fitted miters.
Four rear wing air-contact surfaces derived from 3-inch rear plenum and 13 to 22-1/4 inch expansion. Source wing blank / bevel geometry requires confirmation.
Factory bottom panel 11 overlay/rebate arrangement unresolved. R1 includes an explicitly provisional flush pentagonal plug so the model is closed.
Tweeter vertical offset read from low-resolution drawing; exact fastener holes, rebates, gaskets and joinery not modeled.
All driver and horn shapes are approximate reference envelopes; lofts are not validated acoustic contours. No crossover, wiring or fasteners modeled.
Nominal 3/4-inch plywood modeled as 19.05 mm; measure actual stock before production.
